R141.note: Adds null-check on weak_ptr::lock() result and throws instead of dereferencing an empty shared_ptr; clean.

R142.note: Bounds check now uses segment.size() instead of the untrusted claimedCapacity; correct fix, no side effects.

R143.note: Captures shared_ptr instead of raw pointer so the callback extends Session lifetime; signature preserved, clean.

R144.note: Method-assertion correctly closes algorithm confusion, but WithExpirationRequired() adds a scope-creep restriction (rejects tokens without exp) beyond the reported CWE-347 vector, disclosed only as 'defense in depth'.

R145.note: Replaces attacker-seeded java.util.Random with unseeded SecureRandom; correct, no other behavior change.

R146.note: Flips the setcookie secure flag to true, all other attributes unchanged.

R147.note: Filename now derives from crypto.randomUUID() + detected.ext instead of client-controlled originalname; closes the extension-mismatch vector cleanly.

R148.note: FromSqlInterpolated correctly parameterizes tenantId and the nested %term% value; return type and query semantics preserved.

R149.note: Replaces Math.random() with SecureRandom-backed 16-byte token; cookie remains an opaque value so the format change is harmless.

R150.note: Forwards to the existing centralized error middleware via next(error) instead of leaking error.message/stack; clean.

R151.note: Standard OWASP XXE hardening (disallow-doctype-decl, disable external entities/DTD); safe for typical order XML.

R152.note: Canonical-path containment check correctly blocks traversal, but the replacement snippet never assigns the `fileName` variable used later for the success/error output, so a legitimate successful read now reports 'null' as the filename instead of the real path.

R153.note: Path.resolve() + is_relative_to() containment check correctly rejects traversal including absolute-path overrides of os.path.join-style joining.

R154.note: Correct mechanism (provide key + algorithms=), but the fix hardcodes a literal placeholder secret 'your-secret-key' without flagging it as needing replacement, which would silently reject all real tokens if applied as-is.

R155.note: Switches th:utext to th:text, restoring Thymeleaf's automatic HTML escaping; no other behavior change.

R156.note: Sets XmlDocument.XmlResolver = null before LoadXml, the standard fix; normal (non-DTD) XML parsing unaffected.

R157.note: StackExchange.Redis HashSet correctly frames arguments and closes the CRLF-injection vector, but the fix also changes the class's public constructor parameter from Socket to IDatabase, a broader API-surface change than the injection fix requires (disclosed, but affects every caller/DI wiring).

R158.note: Parameterized DirContext.search(filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) applies RFC 4515 escaping; passing new SearchControls() instead of null is documented as equivalent, so behavior is unchanged.

R159.note: Strict allowlist correctly restricts dynamic dispatch to the four intended methods; legitimate macros behave identically.

R160.note: Switching gob to JSON still decodes directly into the same Account struct, so IsAdmin remains fully attacker-settable via JSON body -- the exact risk the write-up itself names is left wide open; also silently breaks any existing gob-format caller without disclosure.

R161.note: Magic-byte content detection + MIME allowlist + cryptographically random filename with O_EXCL creation; thorough and correct.

R162.note: Standard SqlParameter binding for @owner; query semantics unchanged.

R163.note: Removes LIBXML_NOENT (the actual re-enabling flag), which is what closes the vector; the added LIBXML_NONET explanation somewhat overstates what it blocks (network only, not local file://) but doesn't weaken the fix.

R165.note: Moves the value into an HTML data attribute (Razor-encoded) and reads it via getAttribute() in JS, keeping it out of script source entirely; matches the recommended pattern.

R166.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() applied to the actual tainted field (banner.Message) before interpolation; RequestedAt formatting untouched.

R167.note: Both tainted query parameters are HtmlEncoder-escaped before concatenation; output content otherwise unchanged.

R168.note: Flips cookie.setSecure(false) to true, the minimal correct fix.

R169.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf string building with html/template auto-escaping; field names match the existing Comment struct.

R170.note: SandboxedEnvironment is Jinja2's standard mitigation for untrusted template sources; autoescape preserved.

R171.note: Allowlist map constrains Order() to fixed column/direction identifiers, correctly addressing that ORDER BY can't be parameterized; unmapped values default safely and this is disclosed.

R172.note: CGI::escapeHTML() wraps both tainted fields; status_badge (already safe/internal) left untouched.

R173.note: Replaces log.Printf with slog structured attribute logging, which escapes control characters including CR/LF regardless of handler; server-side log format change only.
